verses.text: Blessed is the man
but his delight is in the law of the LORD,
He is like a tree
The wicked are not so,
Therefore the wicked will not stand in the judgment,
for the LORD knows the way of the righteous,
Why do the nations conspire
The kings of the earth set themselves,
“Let us burst their bonds asunder,
He who sits in the heavens laughs;
Then he will speak to them in his wrath,
“I have set my king
I will tell of the decree of the LORD:
Ask of me, and I will make the nations your heritage,
You shall break them with a rod of iron,
Now therefore, O kings, be wise;
Serve the LORD with fear,
rejoice,
O LORD, how many are my foes!
many are saying of me,
But you, O LORD, are a shield about me,
I cry aloud to the LORD,
I lie down and sleep;
I am not afraid of ten thousands of people
Arise, O LORD!
Deliverance belongs to the LORD;
Answer me when I call, O God of my right!
O sons of men, how long will you be dull of heart?
But know that the LORD has set apart the godly for himself;
Be angry, but sin not;
Offer right sacrifices,
There are many who say, “O that we might see some good!
You have put more joy in my heart
In peace I will both lie down and sleep;
Give ear to my words, O LORD;
Listen to the sound of my cry,
O LORD, in the morning you hear my voice;
For you are not a God who delights in wickedness;
The boastful may not stand before your eyes;
You destroy those who speak lies;
But I through the abundance of your merciful love
Lead me, O LORD, in your righteousness
For there is no truth in their mouth;
Make them bear their guilt, O God;
But let all who take refuge in you rejoice,
For you bless the righteous, O LORD;
O LORD, rebuke me not in your anger,
Have mercy on me, O LORD, for I am languishing;
My soul also is sorely troubled.
Turn, O Lord, save my life;
For in death there is no remembrance of you;
I am weary with my moaning;
My eye wastes away because of grief,
Depart from me, all you workers of evil;
The LORD has heard my supplication;
All my enemies shall be ashamed and sorely troubled;
O LORD my God, in you I take refuge;
lest like a lion they rend me,
O LORD my God, if I have done this,
if I have repaid my friend with evil
let the enemy pursue me and overtake me,
Arise, O LORD, in your anger,
Let the assembly of the peoples be gathered about you;
The LORD judges the peoples;
O let the evil of the wicked come to an end,
My shield is with God,
God is a righteous judge,
If a man does not repent, God will whet his sword;
he has prepared his deadly weapons,
Behold, the wicked man conceives evil,
He makes a pit, digging it out,
His mischief returns upon his own head,
I will give to the LORD the thanks due to his righteousness,
O LORD, our Lord,
by the mouth of babies and infants,
When I look at your heavens, the work of your fingers,
what is man that you are mindful of him,
Yet you have made him little less than the angels,
You have given him dominion over the works of your hands;
all sheep and oxen,
the birds of the air, and the fish of the sea,
O LORD, our Lord,
I will give thanks to the LORD with my whole heart;
I will be glad and exult in you,
When my enemies turned back,
For you have maintained my just cause;
You have rebuked the nations, you have destroyed the wicked;
The enemies have vanished in everlasting ruins;
But the LORD sits enthroned for ever,
and he judges the world with righteousness,
The LORD is a stronghold for the oppressed,
And those who know your name put their trust in you,
Sing praises to the LORD, who dwells in Zion!
For he who avenges blood is mindful of them;
Be gracious to me, O LORD!
that I may recount all your praises,
The nations have sunk in the pit which they made;
The LORD has made himself known, he has executed judgment;
The wicked shall depart to Sheol,
For the needy shall not always be forgotten,
Arise, O LORD! Let not man prevail;
Put them in fear, O LORD!
Why do you stand afar off, O LORD?
In arrogance the wicked hotly pursue the poor;
For the wicked boasts of the desires of his heart,
In the pride of his countenance the wicked does not seek him;
His ways prosper at all times;
He thinks in his heart, “I shall not be moved;
His mouth is filled with cursing and deceit and oppression;
He sits in ambush in the villages;
he lurks in secret like a lion in his den;
The hapless is crushed, sinks down,
He thinks in his heart, “God has forgotten,
Arise, O LORD; O God, lift up your hand;
Why does the wicked renounce God,
You see; yes, you note trouble and vexation,
Break the arm of the wicked and evildoer;
The LORD is king for ever and ever;
O LORD, you will hear the desire of the meek;
to do justice to the fatherless and the oppressed,
[10] In the LORD I take refuge;
for behold, the wicked bend the bow,
if the foundations are destroyed,
The LORD is in his holy temple,
The LORD tests the righteous and the wicked,
On the wicked he will rain coals of fire and brimstone;
For the LORD is righteous, he loves righteous deeds;
[11] Help, LORD; for there is no longer any one that is godly;
Every one utters lies to his neighbor;
May the LORD cut off all flattering lips,
those who say, “With our tongue we will prevail,
“Because the poor are despoiled, because the needy groan,
The promises of the LORD are promises that are pure,
Do, O LORD, protect us,
On every side the wicked prowl,
[12] How long, O LORD? Will you forget me for ever?
How long must I bear pain in my soul,
Consider and answer me, O LORD my God;
lest my enemy say, “I have prevailed over him”;
But I have trusted in your merciful love;
I will sing to the LORD,
[13] The fool says in his heart, “There is no God.”
The LORD looks down from heaven upon the children of men,
They have all gone astray, they are all alike corrupt;
Have they no knowledge, all the evildoers
There they shall be in great terror,
You would confound the plans of the poor,
O that deliverance for Israel would come out of Zion!
[14] O LORD, who shall sojourn in your tent?
He who walks blamelessly, and does what is right,
who does not slander with his tongue,
in whose eyes a reprobate is despised,
who does not put out his money at interest,
[15] Preserve me, O God, for in you I take refuge.
I say to the Lord, “You are my Lord;
As for the saints in the land, they are the noble,
Those who choose another god multiply their sorrows;
The LORD is my chosen portion and my cup;
The lines have fallen for me in pleasant places;
I bless the LORD who gives me counsel;
I keep the LORD always before me;
Therefore my heart is glad, and my soul rejoices;
For you do not give me up to Sheol,
You show me the path of life;
[16] Hear a just cause, O LORD;
From you let my vindication come!
If you try my heart, if you visit me by night,
With regard to the works of men, by the word of your lips
My steps have held fast to your paths,
I call upon you, for you will answer me, O God;
Wondrously show your mercies,
Keep me as the apple of the eye;
from the wicked who despoil me,
They close their hearts to pity;
They track me down; now they surround me;
They are like a lion eager to tear,
Arise, O LORD! confront them, overthrow them!
from men by your hand, O LORD,
As for me, I shall behold your face in righteousness;
The LORD is my rock, and my fortress, and my deliverer,
I call upon the LORD, who is worthy to be praised,
The cords of death encompassed me,
the cords of Sheol entangled me,
In my distress I called upon the LORD;
Then the earth reeled and rocked;
Smoke went up from his nostrils,
He bowed the heavens, and came down;
He rode on a cherub, and flew;
He made darkness his covering around him,
Out of the brightness before him
The LORD also thundered in the heavens,
And he sent out his arrows, and scattered them;
Then the channels of the sea were seen,
He reached from on high, he took me,
He delivered me from my strong enemy,
They came upon me in the day of my calamity;
He brought me forth into a broad place;
The LORD rewarded me according to my righteousness;
For I have kept the ways of the LORD,
For all his ordinances were before me,
I was blameless before him,
Therefore the LORD has recompensed me according to my righteousness,
With the loyal you show yourself loyal;
with the pure you show yourself pure;
For you deliver a humble people;
Yes, you light my lamp;
Yes, by you I can crush a troop;
This God—his way is perfect;
For who is God, but the LORD?
the God who girded me with strength,
He made my feet like deer’s feet,
He trains my hands for war,
You have given me the shield of your salvation,
You gave a wide place for my steps under me,
I pursued my enemies and overtook them;
I thrust them through, so that they were not able to rise;
For you girded me with strength for the battle;
You made my enemies turn their backs to me,
They cried for help, but there was none to save,
I beat them fine as dust before the wind;
You delivered me from strife with the peoples;
As soon as they heard of me they obeyed me;
Foreigners lost heart,
The LORD lives; and blessed be my rock,
the God who gave me vengeance
who delivered me from my enemies;
For this I will extol you, O LORD, among the nations,
Great triumphs he gives to his king,
[18] The heavens are telling the glory of God;
Day to day pours forth speech,
There is no speech, nor are there words;
yet their voice goes out through all the earth,
which comes forth like a bridegroom leaving his chamber,
Its rising is from the end of the heavens,
The law of the LORD is perfect,
the precepts of the LORD are right,
the fear of the LORD is clean,
More to be desired are they than gold,
Moreover by them is your servant warned;
But who can discern his errors?
Keep back your servant also from presumptuous sins;
Let the words of my mouth and the meditation of my heart
[19] The LORD answer you in the day of trouble!
May he send you help from the sanctuary,
May he remember all your offerings,
May he grant you your heart’s desire,
May we shout for joy over your victory,
Now I know that the LORD will help his anointed;
Some boast of chariots, and some of horses;
They will collapse and fall;
Give victory to the king, O LORD;
[20] In your strength the king rejoices, O LORD;
You have given him his heart’s desire,
For you meet him with goodly blessings;
He asked life of you; you gave it to him,
His glory is great through your help;
Yes, you make him most blessed for ever;
For the king trusts in the LORD;
Your hand will find out all your enemies;
You will make them as a blazing oven
You will destroy their offspring from the earth,
If they plan evil against you,
For you will put them to flight;
Be exalted, O LORD, in your strength!
O my God, I cry by day, but you do not answer;
Yet you are holy,
In you our fathers trusted;
To you they cried, and were saved;
But I am a worm, and no man;
All who see me mock at me,
“He committed his cause to the LORD; let him deliver him,
Yet you are he who took me from the womb;
Upon you was I cast from my birth,
Be not far from me,
Many bulls encompass me,
they open wide their mouths at me,
I am poured out like water,
my strength is dried up like a potsherd,
Yes, dogs are round about me;
I can count all my bones—
they divide my garments among them,
But you, O LORD, be not far off!
Deliver my soul from the sword,
Save me from the mouth of the lion,
I will tell of your name to my brethren;
You who fear the LORD, praise him!
For he has not despised or abhorred
From you comes my praise in the great congregation;
The afflicted shall eat and be satisfied;
All the ends of the earth shall remember
For dominion belongs to the LORD,
Yes, to him shall all the proud of the earth bow down;
Posterity shall serve him;
and proclaim his deliverance to a people yet unborn,
[22] The LORD is my shepherd, I shall not want;
he makes me lie down in green pastures.
he restores my soul.
Even though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death,
You prepare a table before me
Surely goodness and mercy shall follow me
for he has founded it upon the seas,
Who shall ascend the hill of the LORD?
He who has clean hands and a pure heart,
He will receive blessing from the LORD,
Such is the generation of those who seek him,
Lift up your heads, O gates!
Who is the King of glory?
Lift up your heads, O gates!
Who is this King of glory?
[24] To you, O LORD, I lift up my soul.
O my God, in you I trust,
Yes, let none that wait for you be put to shame;
Make me to know your ways, O LORD;
Lead me in your truth, and teach me,
Be mindful of your compassion, O LORD, and of your merciful love,
Remember not the sins of my youth, or my transgressions;
Good and upright is the LORD;
He leads the humble in what is right,
All the paths of the LORD are mercy and faithfulness,
For your name’s sake, O LORD,
Who is the man that fears the LORD?
He himself shall abide in prosperity,
The friendship of the LORD is for those who fear him,
My eyes are ever toward the LORD,
Turn to me, and be gracious to me;
Relieve the troubles of my heart,
Consider my affliction and my trouble,
Consider how many are my foes,
Oh, guard my life, and deliver me;
May integrity and uprightness preserve me,
Redeem Israel, O God,
[25] Vindicate me, O LORD,
Prove me, O LORD, and try me;
For your mercy is before my eyes,
I do not sit with false men,
I hate the company of evildoers,
I wash my hands in innocence,
singing aloud a song of thanksgiving,
O LORD, I love the habitation of your house,
Sweep me not away with sinners,
men in whose hands are evil devices,
But as for me, I walk in my integrity;
My foot stands on level ground;
[26] The LORD is my light and my salvation;
When evildoers assail me,
Though a host encamp against me,
One thing have I asked of the LORD,
For he will hide me in his shelter
And now my head shall be lifted up
Hear, O LORD, when I cry aloud,
You have said, “Seek my face.”
Hide not your face from me.
For my father and my mother have forsaken me,
Teach me your way, O LORD;
Give me not up to the will of my adversaries;
I believe that I shall see the goodness of the LORD
Wait for the LORD;
[27] To you, O LORD, I call;
Hear the voice of my supplication,
Take me not off with the wicked,
Repay them according to their work,
Because they do not regard the works of the LORD,
Blessed be the LORD!
The LORD is my strength and my shield;
The LORD is the strength of his people,
O save your people, and bless your heritage;
[28] Ascribe to the LORD, O sons of God,
Ascribe to the LORD the glory of his name;
The voice of the LORD is upon the waters;
The voice of the LORD is powerful,
The voice of the LORD breaks the cedars,
He makes Lebanon to skip like a calf,
The voice of the LORD flashes forth flames of fire.
The voice of the LORD shakes the wilderness,
The voice of the LORD makes the oaks to whirl,
The LORD sits enthroned over the flood;
May the LORD give strength to his people!
[29] I will extol you, O LORD, for you have drawn me up,
O LORD my God, I cried to you for help,
O LORD, you have brought up my soul from Sheol,
Sing praises to the LORD, O you his saints,
For his anger is but for a moment,
As for me, I said in my prosperity,
By your favor, O LORD,
To you, O LORD, I cried;
“What profit is there in my death,
Hear, O LORD, and be gracious to me!
You have turned my mourning into dancing;
that my soul may praise you and not be silent.
[30] In you, O LORD, I seek refuge;
Incline your ear to me,
Yes, you are my rock and my fortress;
take me out of the net which is hidden for me,
Into your hand I commit my spirit;
You hate those who pay regard to vain idols;
I will rejoice and be glad for your merciful love,
and have not delivered me into the hand of the enemy;
Be gracious to me, O LORD, for I am in distress;
For my life is spent with sorrow,
I am the scorn of all my adversaries,
I have passed out of mind like one who is dead;
Yes, I hear the whispering of many—
But I trust in you, O LORD,
My times are in your hand;
Let your face shine on your servant;
Let me not be put to shame, O LORD,
Let the lying lips be silent,
O how abundant is your goodness,
In the shelter of your presence you hide them
Blessed be the LORD,
I had said in my alarm,
Love the LORD, all you his saints!
Be strong, and let your heart take courage,
Blessed is the man to whom the LORD imputes no iniquity,
When I declared not my sin, my body wasted away
For day and night your hand was heavy upon me;
I acknowledged my sin to you,
Therefore let every one who is godly
You are a hiding place for me,
I will instruct you and teach you
Be not like a horse or a mule, without understanding,
Many are the pangs of the wicked;
Be glad in the LORD, and rejoice, O righteous,
[32] Rejoice in the LORD, O you righteous!
Praise the LORD with the lyre,
Sing to him a new song,
For the word of the LORD is upright;
He loves righteousness and justice;
By the word of the LORD the heavens were made,
He gathered the waters of the sea as in a bottle;
Let all the earth fear the LORD,
For he spoke, and it came to be;
The LORD brings the counsel of the nations to nought;
The counsel of the LORD stands for ever,
Blessed is the nation whose God is the LORD,
The LORD looks down from heaven,
from where he sits enthroned he looks forth
he who fashions the hearts of them all,
A king is not saved by his great army;
The war horse is a vain hope for victory,
Behold, the eye of the LORD is on those who fear him,
that he may deliver their soul from death,
Our soul waits for the LORD;
Yes, our heart is glad in him,
Let your mercy, O LORD, be upon us,
[33] I will bless the LORD at all times;
My soul makes its boast in the LORD;
O magnify the LORD with me,
I sought the LORD, and he answered me,
Look to him, and be radiant;
This poor man cried, and the LORD heard him,
The angel of the LORD encamps
O taste and see that the LORD is good!
O fear the LORD, you his saints,
The young lions suffer want and hunger;
Come, O sons, listen to me,
What man is there who desires life,
Keep your tongue from evil,
Depart from evil, and do good;
The eyes of the LORD are toward the righteous,
The face of the LORD is against evildoers,
When the righteous cry for help, the LORD hears,
The LORD is near to the brokenhearted,
Many are the afflictions of the righteous;
He keeps all his bones;
Evil shall slay the wicked;
The LORD redeems the life of his servants;
[34] Contend, O LORD, with those who contend with me;
Take hold of shield and buckler,
Draw the spear and javelin
Let them be put to shame and dishonor
Let them be like chaff before the wind,
Let their way be dark and slippery,
For without cause they hid their net for me;
Let ruin come upon them unawares!
Then my soul shall rejoice in the LORD,
All my bones shall say,
Malicious witnesses rise up;
They repay me evil for good;
But I, when they were sick—
as though I grieved for my friend or my brother;
But at my stumbling they gathered in glee,
they impiously mocked more and more,
How long, O LORD, will you look on?
Then I will thank you in the great congregation;
Let not those rejoice over me
For they do not speak peace,
They open wide their mouths against me;
You have seen, O LORD; be not silent!
Bestir yourself, and awake for my right,
Vindicate me, O LORD, my God, according to your righteousness;
Let them not say to themselves,
Let them be put to shame and confusion altogether
Let those who desire my vindication
Then my tongue shall tell of your righteousness
For he flatters himself in his own eyes
The words of his mouth are mischief and deceit;
He plots mischief while on his bed;
Your mercy, O LORD, extends to the heavens,
Your righteousness is like the mountains of God,
How precious is your mercy, O God!
They feast on the abundance of your house,
For with you is the fountain of life;
O continue your steadfast love to those who know you,
Let not the foot of arrogance come upon me,
There the evildoers lie prostrate,
[36] Do not fret because of the wicked,
For they will soon fade like the grass,
Trust in the LORD, and do good;
Take delight in the LORD,
Commit your way to the LORD;
He will bring forth your vindication as the light,
Be still before the LORD, and wait patiently for him;
Refrain from anger, and forsake wrath!
For the wicked shall be cut off;
Yet a little while, and the wicked will be no more;
But the meek shall possess the land,
The wicked plots against the righteous,
but the LORD laughs at the wicked,
The wicked draw the sword and bend their bows,
their sword shall enter their own heart,
Better is a little that the righteous has
For the arms of the wicked shall be broken;
The LORD knows the days of the blameless,
they are not put to shame in evil times,
But the wicked perish;
The wicked borrows, and cannot pay back,
for those blessed by the LORD shall possess the land,
The steps of a man are from the LORD,
though he fall, he shall not be cast headlong,
I have been young, and now am old;
He is ever giving liberally and lending,
Depart from evil, and do good;
For the LORD loves justice;
The righteous shall possess the land,
The mouth of the righteous utters wisdom,
The law of his God is in his heart;
The wicked watches the righteous,
The LORD will not abandon him to his power,
Wait for the LORD, and keep to his way,
I have seen a wicked man overbearing,
Again I passed by, and, behold, he was no more;
Mark the blameless man, and behold the upright,
But transgressors shall be altogether destroyed;
The salvation of the righteous is from the LORD;
The LORD helps them and delivers them;
[37] O LORD, rebuke me not in your anger,
For your arrows have sunk into me,
There is no soundness in my flesh
For my iniquities have gone over my head;
My wounds grow foul and fester
I am utterly bowed down and prostrate;
For my loins are filled with burning,
I am utterly spent and crushed;
Lord, all my longing is known to you,
My heart throbs, my strength fails me;
My friends and companions stand aloof from my plague,
Those who seek my life lay their snares,
But I am like a deaf man, I do not hear,
Yes, I am like a man who does not hear,
But for you, O LORD, do I wait;
For I pray, “Only let them not rejoice over me,
For I am ready to fall,
I confess my iniquity,
Those who are my foes without cause are mighty,
Those who render me evil for good
Do not forsake me, O LORD!
Make haste to help me,
[38] I said, “I will guard my ways,
I was mute and silent,
my heart became hot within me.
“LORD, let me know my end,
Behold, you have made my days a few handbreadths,
Surely man goes about as a shadow!
“And now, Lord, for what do I wait?
Deliver me from all my transgressions.
I am silent, I do not open my mouth;
Remove your stroke from me;
When you chasten man
“Hear my prayer, O LORD,
Look away from me, that I may know gladness,
[39] I waited patiently for the LORD;
He drew me up from the desolate pit,
He put a new song in my mouth,
Blessed is the man who makes
You have multiplied, O LORD my God,
Sacrifice and offering you do not desire;
Then I said, “Behold, I come;
I delight to do your will, O my God;
I have told the glad news of deliverance
I have not hidden your saving help within my heart,
Do not, O LORD, withhold
For evils have encompassed me
Be pleased, O LORD, to deliver me!
Let them be put to shame and confusion altogether
Let them be appalled because of their shame
But may all who seek you
As for me, I am poor and needy;
[40] Blessed is he who considers the poor!
the LORD protects him and keeps him alive;
The LORD sustains him on his sickbed;
As for me, I said, “O LORD, be gracious to me;
My enemies say of me in malice:
And when one comes to see me, he utters empty words,
All who hate me whisper together about me;
They say, “A deadly thing has fastened upon him;
Even my bosom friend in whom I trusted,
But you, O LORD, be gracious to me,
By this I know that you are pleased with me,
But you have upheld me because of my integrity,
Blessed be the LORD, the God of Israel,
[41] As a deer longs
My soul thirsts for God,
My tears have been my food
These things I remember,
Why are you cast down, O my soul,
and my God.
Deep calls to deep
By day the LORD commands his steadfast love;
I say to God, my rock:
As with a deadly wound in my body,
Why are you cast down, O my soul,
[42] Vindicate me, O God, and defend my cause
For you are the God in whom I take refuge;
Oh, send out your light and your truth;
Then I will go to the altar of God,
Why are you cast down, O my soul,
[43] We have heard with our ears, O God,
you with your own hand drove out the nations,
for not by their own sword did they win the land,
You are my King and my God,
Through you we push down our foes;
For not in my bow do I trust,
But you have saved us from our foes,
In God we have boasted continually,
Yet you have cast us off and abased us,
You have made us turn back from the foe;
You have made us like sheep for slaughter,
You have sold your people for a trifle,
You have made us the taunt of our neighbors,
You have made us a byword among the nations,
All day long my disgrace is before me,
at the words of the taunters and revilers,
All this has come upon us,
Our heart has not turned back,
that you should have broken us in the place of jackals,
If we had forgotten the name of our God,
would not God discover this?
No, for your sake we are slain all the day long,
Rouse yourself! Why do you sleep, O Lord?
Why do you hide your face?
For our soul is bowed down to the dust;
Rise up, come to our help!
[44] My heart overflows with a goodly theme;
You are the fairest of the sons of men;
Gird your sword upon your thigh, O mighty one,
In your majesty ride forth victoriously
Your arrows are sharp
Your divine throne endures for ever and ever.
you love righteousness and hate wickedness.
your robes are all fragrant with myrrh and aloes and cassia.
daughters of kings are among your ladies of honor;
Hear, O daughter, consider, and incline your ear;
and the king will desire your beauty.
the people of Tyre will court your favor with gifts,
with all kinds of wealth.
in many-colored robes she is led to the king,

Instead of your fathers shall be your sons;
I will cause your name to be celebrated in all generations;
[45] God is our refuge and strength,
Therefore we will not fear though the earth should change,
though its waters roar and foam,
There is a river whose streams make glad the city of God,
God is in the midst of her, she shall not be moved;
The nations rage, the kingdoms totter;
The LORD of hosts is with us;
Come, behold the works of the LORD,
He makes wars cease to the end of the earth;
“Be still, and know that I am God.
The LORD of hosts is with us;
[46] Clap your hands, all peoples!
For the LORD, the Most High, is awesome,
He subdued peoples under us,
He chose our heritage for us,
God has gone up with a shout,
Sing praises to God, sing praises!
For God is the king of all the earth;
God reigns over the nations;
The princes of the peoples gather
[47] Great is the LORD and greatly to be praised
beautiful in elevation,
Within her citadels God
For behold, the kings assembled,
As soon as they saw it, they were astounded,
trembling took hold of them there,
